_comment: Cross-language pairs (F# + TypeScript) with no NAME-MATCHED treaty, golden vectors, or F# replay. This baseline is UNTRIAGED: it records what the roster sees today so a NEW pair fails the audit, and it asserts NOTHING about whether these need a treaty. The 2026-09 hand sweep judged only six of the 68 concepts genuinely unpinned; this roster reports 31 because it matches on names and cannot tell a concept that needs a treaty (IndexedZSet) from one where a treaty is meaningless (Result). Triage moves entries into DECLARED_UNPINNED with a reason, or pins them.
